text: Tustin turns 100 years old next year, and our community is full of energy and optimism. When you elected me four years ago as your mayor, I made commitments to you. Those promises have been kept. Together, we have invested in Tustin’s future, increasing police and fire resources, strengthening our finances, and cleaning up our streets and parks.

My work is dedicated to you. My family plays in our parks and visits our shops and restaurants. My children attend Tustin public schools. We volunteer with our wonderful non-profits. Most of our evenings and weekends are spent on our fields for baseball, football, soccer, or basketball. Everywhere we go, I meet folks who love our town and care deeply about protecting and strengthening our city. And I am honored to serve as your mayor and to help shape a safer, more resilient, and prosperous Tustin for every resident.

Strengthening public safety: I am proud to be endorsed by OC Sheriff Don Barnes, Tustin Police, and OC Firefighters who recognize our success in expanding public safety resources to every neighborhood, business, and school. Our commitments resulted in reduced crime - 35% reduction in violent crime and 17% reduction in property crime - increasing Tustin’s home values and keeping Tustin residents safe.

Reinforcing financial discipline: we delivered strict budget policies that reduced our city’s unfunded pension liabilities and increased rainy-day funds. We are leveraging strategic partnerships and attracting new businesses to increase revenue, instead of increasing taxes.

Cleaning up our community: we are refreshing our beautiful parks and cleaning up our tired streets and medians. We are reducing homelessness and blight by partnering with experts and securing state and federal funding, including creating a facility for families with children experiencing homelessness.

Promoting Tustin’s character: we are investing in Old Town infrastructure and amenities; we are increasing public art; we opened Tustin’s first dog park; and we added to our thousands of city-maintained trees. We are expanding public facilities and promoting sustainable development. Together, we have focused on what makes Tustin special and invested in our future.

I am humbled to be endorsed by a long list of Tustin’s leaders including current Tustin Councilmen Ryan Gallagher, John Nielsen, and Ray Schnell, and a long list of former mayors. Please join them in supporting me.
I would be honored to receive your vote!
To find out more or to join Team Tustin visit www.Austin4Tustin.com

text: As your Mayor and City Councilmember from 2016 to 2024, I led Tustin through COVID-19, protected small businesses, supported frontline workers, approved more than 2,100 new homes at Tustin Legacy, and made City Hall more accessible through online meetings and the Engage Tustin app.

Tustin is home. I graduated from Tustin High School, built my career through education, culminating in earning my doctorate, and with my husband we’ve proudly raised our three children here. Those experiences shape every decision I make and keep me focused on building a Tustin where every family can thrive.

I'm running for Mayor to put that experience to work again with a clear plan for Tustin's future. That means supporting local businesses, investing in parks, roads, housing, public safety, emergency preparedness, and mental health services, while partnering with our schools to expand mentorship and career opportunities for young people. My goal is to make Tustin the best city it can be for today's residents and the next generation, including my own children.
You know my record, my values, and my commitment to this community. I respectfully ask for your vote for Mayor on or before November 3, 2026.
To learn more, please visit www.letitiaclark.com
